scenarios.name: add-commercial
scenarios.why: the commercial path: INSERT COMMERCIAL (perils and premiums)

scenarios.name: add-endowment
scenarios.why: INSERT-ENDOW, the caller passed exactly the required 152 bytes (28 header + 124): WS-VARY-LEN 0, the INSERT without PADDINGDATA (X23: no storage overlay at this length, X8)

scenarios.name: add-endowment-padded
scenarios.why: INSERT-ENDOW, the caller passed the record's full 32500 bytes, 32348 over the required 152 (X23: the whole of CA-E-PADDING-DATA is within EIBCALEN, so the MOVE reads nothing past it): SUBTRACT GIVING the PIC S9(4) COMP WS-VARY-LEN truncates 32348 to 2348 (TRUNC(STD)), which is greater than zero, so CA-E-PADDING-DATA moves into WS-VARY-CHAR(1:2348) and the INSERT with PADDINGDATA runs (line 342 true arm)

scenarios.name: add-endowment-short
scenarios.why: one byte under the required 152: '98' to CA-RETURN-CODE, RETURN before any INSERT or LINK

scenarios.name: unknown-request
scenarios.why: no WHEN for the request id: '99', RETURN before any INSERT or LINK

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the no-commarea arm of the entry check, then WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE and ABEND

scenarios.name: policy-insert-fk-violation
scenarios.why: INSERT POLICY refused with -530 (foreign-key violation): '70' to CA-RETURN-CODE, WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE with a commarea over 90 bytes, RETURN

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgapdb01: CUSTOMER, POLICY and the four type tables are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (identity numbers, FKs POLICY->CUSTOMER and type->POLICY, NULLs and boundary values); CUSTOMERNUMBER is stated 1..10 so the stated scenarios' customers 1, 2, 4 and 8 exist. 24 generated add-policy requests (house / motor / commercial / unknown id in turn) draw CA-CUSTOMER-NUM from the generated customers. Not generated: a customer none holds (-530 on the POLICY INSERT, whose WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE stamps the message with ASKTIME / FORMATTIME: in a LINKed COBOL task that reads 1900-01-01 where the Java side reads the case clock, and LGSTSQ's WRITEQ is X6). The endowment path is not generated (storage overlay, X8). GenApp's add-policy service (LGAPDB01, LINKed with the LGCMAREA COMMAREA, described by its caller LGAPOL01's record): the POLICY row is INSERTed with Db2's identity number and LASTCHANGED = CURRENT TIMESTAMP, the number read back with SET :H = IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() and LASTCHANGED with a SELECT, then the type's row (ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR / COMMERCIAL), and LGAPVS01 (run in the same task) writes the VSAM copy. POLICY.LASTCHANGED and CA-LASTCHANGED (CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC(31:26)) are clock fields, as is COMMERCIAL.REQUESTDATE (CURRENT TIMESTAMP too). A customer that does not exist is -530 ('70'), which LINKs LGSTSQ (oracle_assumptions.md X6): not here. Not here either: the endowment path MOVEs CA-E-PADDING-DATA into WS-VARY-CHAR(1:EIBCALEN - the required length), which with the 32500-byte COMMAREA its caller passes runs far past WS-VARY-CHAR's 3900 bytes -- a storage overlay (no SSRANGE) no oracle here can judge (oracle_assumptions.md X8).
